name: pubmed-bio
description: Evidence-graded PubMed search for AI agents — biohacking, supplementation, and clinical decision support.

ncbiEmail.title: NCBI contact email
ncbiEmail.description: NCBI asks for a contact email on every E-utilities request. Recommended to avoid throttling.

ncbiApiKey.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbiApiKey.description: Raises the NCBI rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second. Leave blank if you don't have one.

llmProvider.title: LLM provider for deep grading
llmProvider.description: One of: openai, anthropic, local. Used by the pubmed_grade tool.

llmApiKey.title: LLM API key
llmApiKey.description: API key for the chosen LLM provider. Leave blank to disable deep grading (pubmed_grade falls back to keyword grading).
